lulu.why: R has no damage at all (health/size/knockup only) and W's enemy branch is pure CC a damage-maximizing cast would skip against a dummy, so only its self-cast attack-speed buff matters. P's on-hit bolts and Q's dual bolt are plain damage; E's enemy cast is a plain-cast burst that also pulls Pix away, briefly suspending P's on-hit bolts - the one open detail.
